items.title: EIP-8141：加入用于交易过期的 EXPIRY_VERIFIER frame
items.note: （nerolation）合并：通过指向 `EXPIRY_VERIFIER` 的 `VERIFY` frame 设定过期，并放宽 `VERIFY`，在回滚时使交易无效。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: add an EXPIRY_VERIFIER frame for tx expiry
items.note_en: (nerolation), merged: expiry is set through a `VERIFY` frame targeting `EXPIRY_VERIFIER`, and `VERIFY` is relaxed to invalidate the transaction on revert.

items.title: EIP-7851：根据论坛讨论调整措辞
items.note: （colinlyguo）提交并合并，澄清 frame 内执行语义和交易有效性。
items.title_en: EIP-7851: tweak wording based on forum discussions
items.note_en: (colinlyguo), submitted and merged, clarifying frame-local execution semantics and transaction validity.

items.note_en: (RogerPodacter), submitted and merged. EIP-8182 defines protocol level private ETH and ERC-20 transfers.

summary_en: nerolation's EIP-8141 EXPIRY_VERIFIER frame was merged, so a transaction can set an expiry through a VERIFY frame targeting the expiry verifier. RogerPodacter updated EIP-8182, private ETH and ERC-20 transfers, and it was merged. EIP-7851 wording was tweaked based on forum discussion. Ethereal news #23 was published.
